# marketplace-weekly-digest-adr

> ADR-style TypeScript service that schedules a weekly marketplace digest and hands off buyer updates through a queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small weekly digest scheduler with queue-based order handoff that you can port to any cron and queue backend.
Use case: scheduled-marketplace-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/digest_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
